name: Modest Apparel
overview: Scripture instructs believers to honor God through their appearance by maintaining distinctions in gender-specific clothing and avoiding attire that promotes pride or immodesty. The Lord condemns adopting garments of the opposite sex as an abomination, emphasizing clear boundaries between men and women. Additionally, the Bible warns against dressing in ways that are provocative or lacking discretion, likening such behavior to folly and haughtiness that dishonors God. True strength and godly character are reflected not in outward adornment but in modesty, humility, and integrity.
